industry.name: Oil & Gas Related Equipment and Services

profile.description: ADNOC Drilling Company P.J.S.C. engages in the provision of drilling and construction services in the United Arab Emirates. It operates through Onshore, Offshore, and Oilfield Services (OFS) segments. The company offers drilling and construction services for conventional and unconventional reservoirs; rigs, water wells, work over rigs, and Island rigs; and cluster drilling and offshore infrastructure, as well as operates integrated drilling services. It also offers hiring out of onshore and offshore drilling rigs to parties involved in oil and gas exploration and production; and oil field services, including directional drilling, wireline, pressure pumping, logging, and fluids services. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates. ADNOC Drilling Company P.J.S.C. is a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company.

finsights.brief: Has raised its dividend for 4 consecutive years
2 analysts have revised their earnings downwards for the upcoming period

summary: ADNOC Drilling reported record 9-month revenue of $3.7B and net profit of $1.1B; Q3 revenue rose 1% sequentially to $1.2B.
Board approved $175M discretionary dividend, raising 2026 total dividends to $1.225B, up 22.5% year-over-year with 4.62% yield.
Company unveiled 'Drill-to-Operate' strategy to expand beyond drilling into completion, artificial lift, and production solutions.
Management confirmed 2026 guidance of ~$5.0B revenue and ~$1.45B net profit; expects low-to-mid single-digit growth in 2027.
Capex to rise to ~$800M in 2027 from ~$600M in 2026; net debt-to-EBITDA held at conservative 1.0x with 36% ROE.
